name: Nurse Boy 0
source:
'Nurse Boy 0' is a short visual novel, made to celebrate Valentine's day. Play as Mc, who really wants to date a Nurse Boy (Medsestra) he just met.

[From [url=https://bun-tired.itch.io/nurse-boy-0]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《护士男孩0》是一部短篇视觉小说，为庆祝情人节而制作。扮演Mc，他真的很想和他刚认识的男孩护士 (Medsestra) 约会。

[来自[url=https://bun-tired.itch.io/nurse-boy-0]itch.io[/url]]
